itemUsage.en: Rhodes Island Chief Engineer Closure, on the front lines as a vanguard!
itemUsage.zh: 罗德岛总工程师可露希尔，以先锋身份亲临前线！

itemDesc.en: When she comes to the front lines, she brings her tools, her drones, her snacks, and a brain full of engineering problems in need of urgent solving.
itemDesc.zh: 和她一起亲临前线的还有工具组、无人机、零食，以及她脑子里那些亟待解决的工程问题。

description.en: Grants Reinforcements <@ba.vup>{shield_cnt}</> Shield (does not stack); gradually generates <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP over skill duration; each time this skill is used, DP gained <@ba.vup>+{cost_per_add}</> (up to <@ba.vup>{cost_add_max}</> DP)
description.zh: 立即使自身的援军获得<@ba.vup>{shield_cnt}</>层<$ba.shield>护盾</>（不叠加），技能持续时间内逐渐获得<@ba.vup>{cost}</>点部署费用；部署后每使用过一次技能，获得的部署费用<@ba.vup>+{cost_per_add}</>（最多提升至<@ba.vup>{cost_add_max}</>点）

description.en: Immediately generates <@ba.vup>{cost}</> DP, gradually generates <@ba.vup>{cost_period}</> DP over skill duration, Reinforcements DEF <@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</>, Block <@ba.vup>+{block_cnt}</>, Closure's ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> targets simultaneously, and can attack enemies blocked by her own Reinforcements; Operators deployed within Tactical Point effect range refund <@ba.vup>{cost_return:0%}</> of their DP cost

description.en: Gradually generates <@ba.vup>{cost_period}</> DP over skill duration, and Attack Interval decreases; locks onto and attacks enemies within Closure or her Reinforcements' normal Attack Ranges, dealing <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of Closure's ATK as Physical damage and inflicting a <@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down:0%}</> <$ba.slowdown>Sluggish</> effect for <@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down_time}</>s (stacks up to <@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down_max:0%}</>); target count +1 after every <@ba.vup>{attack_trigger_cnt}</> attacks (can trigger up to <@ba.vup>{max_trigger_cnt}</> times)
description.zh: 技能持续时间内逐渐获得<@ba.vup>{cost_period}</>点部署费用，攻击间隔缩短，锁定自身和援军原本攻击范围内的敌人进行攻击，造成可露希尔<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的物理伤害并施加持续<@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down_time}</>秒的<@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down:0%}</><$ba.slowdown>迟钝</>效果（可叠加，最高<@ba.vup>{attack@slow_down_max:0%}</>），每攻击<@ba.vup>{attack_trigger_cnt}</>次后攻击目标数+1（最多触发<@ba.vup>{max_trigger_cnt}</>次）

description.en:
Operator Closure has demonstrated a remarkable aptitude in the designation of tactical points for summoning reinforcements so as to secure leeway for deployment.
The Field Operations Department has thus passed the following resolution:
This operator shall be appointed a Vanguard Operator during field operations to exercise Tactician responsibilities.
In witness whereof,
This badge is hereby conferred upon the above named.
description.zh:
干员可露希尔擅长布设战术点召唤援军来争取部署空间
根据外勤部门决议
在外勤任务中划分为先锋干员，行使战术家职责
特别颁发此证章
以兹证明

description.en:
[Procurement Department Special Acquisitions List]

Rosin, violin cleaner and maintenance set, Leithanien. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Good to see that Amiya's been playing the violin more since we got back from Zelgrad. She used to say she didn't need any expensive maintenance equipment for it, and I didn't know any better. Only after talking to some Leithanian operators did I learn that good maintenance is always better, no matter the quality of the violin. She deserves it after all this Ursus stuff.

Compilation of various newspapers from across Terra. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Auto-scanner and reader, Kazimierz. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Kal'tsit didn't say anything, but of course she'd want to know what happened while she was gone.
The scanner and reader are gifts from me. So the Kazimierzians CAN make something useful once in a while, a scanner that can automatically turn pages, scan documents, and organize them is hard to find... maybe it was invented by a desperate secretary.

Smart Kettle Modification Kit, Columbia. Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
Basically a Tkaronto smart water purifier refit as a kettle. Because I couldn't find a 'smart kettle' anywhere? What do the Columbians have against kettles, anyway?
...Wait, what's so great about kettles, anyway?
Long story short, it's now operable by voice commands, and can control the water temperature and dispense cold, filtered water directly. Basically a compact water purifier. Like it or not, it's all yours, Doctor.

Handheld Electronic Game Dev Master V10.0, Higashi (Southern Court). Purchase Price: ■■■■. Sales Price: -
......

The recipients of these gifts were concerned that Closure was so busy that she forgot to treat herself, so they prepared their own gifts and went to thank her together. Their worries turned out to be unfounded, however, as they found her snoozing on her desk with a little trophy—in true Closure style—right next to her.
description.zh:
【采购部特殊渠道进货清单】

松香、小提琴清洁剂及维护套组——莱塔尼亚——进价：■■■■，售价：-
从泽尔格勒回来之后，阿米娅拉小提琴的次数多了不少。真让人欣慰。之前阿米娅总说那把小提琴用不着太贵的维护套组，我也不太懂。问了好几个莱塔尼亚的干员才知道，不管小提琴本身如何，精心养护一定是没错的。乌萨斯这一整档子事过去之后，也该好好犒劳一下她了。

各种报纸合订本——泰拉各国——进价：■■■■，售价：-
全自动扫描设备和阅读器——卡西米尔——进价：■■■■，售价：-
凯尔希没说，但这段时间泰拉发生了什么，她肯定想知道。
扫描仪和阅读器就当我送她的了。卡西米尔的厂商偶尔还是能做出些有用的物件，自动翻页自动扫描自动整理的扫描仪在泰拉其他地方可不好找……虽然感觉像是哪个绝望的秘书发明的东西。

热水壶智能化改装组件——哥伦比亚——进价：■■■■，售价：-
说是智能化改装，其实是买了一整台提卡伦多产的智能净水机，再想办法把上面的组件改到热水壶上，因为实在是找不到“智能热水壶”这种东西——哥伦比亚人怎么就体会不到热水壶的好呢！
不对，热水壶有什么好？
……算了，反正现在这把水壶已经可以声控了，能控制水温，还能直出过滤后的冷水，大概相当于一个小型化了的净水机。不管喜不喜欢，这都是博士的了。

掌机游戏开发大师V10.0——东国（南院）——进价：■■■■，售价：-
……

收到了礼物的人们担心可露希尔忙到忘了她自己，于是各自准备了回礼，一起去向可露希尔道谢。不过这样的担心是多余的。他们到工程部时，可露希尔正趴在桌子上呼呼大睡，身旁还放了个很有她个人风格的小奖杯。
